verdict.rationale: Installed plugins bring a user's data into ChatGPT/Codex for AI analysis. The Slack plugin is documented to summarize channels or draft replies, and the Codex Security plugin scans code and confirms plausible vulnerability findings. Both are AI-generated insights and suggestions from user data, but each is only a one-line, per-plugin mention with no depth on analytics or proactive suggestions. missing for 10: a documented general data-insights or analytics capability, detail on proactive suggestions, coverage of structured data such as Sheets or databases beyond 'work with', and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Install the Slack plugin to summarize channels or draft replies.
Install the Codex Security plugin to scan authorized code and confirm plausible vulnerability findings.
Install the Google Drive plugin to work across Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
